deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 at 5:00 pm (US Eastern).

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test is optional.

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is optional.

supervisor.value: You are assigned a first-year mentor and find a research advisor yourself after arrival.
supervisor.quote: Entering PhD students are assigned faculty mentors to support them during their first year. | Each student is expected to exercise initiative in seeking out a dissertation topic, a faculty advisor who will take primary responsibility for supervising the student’s work, and two additional readers.

funding.value: All Harvard Griffin GSAS PhD students get guaranteed funding for the first five years.
funding.quote: Our financial aid program features guaranteed funding for the first five years to all PhD students

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's degree; for international applicants a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from a recognized institution is accepted.
entry_route.quote: welcomes applications for admission from individuals who have or will have by the time of matriculation a BA, BS, or equivalent undergraduate degree (for prospective international students, a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from an institution of recognized standing)

notes: Minimum preparation is linear algebra and advanced calculus. Harvard also runs a separate Biostatistics PhD (GRE General required, deadline Dec 1, 2026).
